evaluation_data.critique_summary: The SVG is a masterclass in layout design and precision. Node alignments, path routings, cut-outs, and bounding boxes are calculated flawlessly, completely avoiding overlaps. The integration of placeholders is strictly maintained with clear, descriptive icons. The only minor detraction is the omission of tensor shapes, which are highly expected in ML methodology visualizations.
specific_issues: Lack of tensor dimensionality annotations (e.g., [B, T, d_model]) along the connecting sequence vectors.
The architecture diagram specifically shows a causal/masked self-attention mechanism, which implies a Decoder-only structure, but the general label 'Transformer Architecture' is used.
improvement_suggestions: Add small, italicized dimension annotations (e.g., 'Batch x Seq_Len x d_model') near the 'Sequence Vectors' and 'Contextual States' badges.
Clarify the architecture panel header by renaming it to 'DECODER-ONLY TRANSFORMER ARCHITECTURE' to be technically precise regarding the masked attention component.
Include an explicit Learning Rate Scheduler visual node branching into the Backpropagation optimizer logic to capture the fully comprehensive training loop.
